Skipped when no sentinels are named.'); sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row 36 (same wording, no internal annotation)
task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (all 41 criteria) and prompt.md (all protocols Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,K,R,V,A,D)
task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml + prompt.md; task/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md; task/tests/gates/render and constraints judge.toml + prompt.md; task/tests/app_context.md

evidence: Probe inventory. The criteria in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml contain no literal probe values. All mutation probes come from the prompts. (a) Records the judge creates with a per-review suffix: functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review)', and the J1/J2/J3 jobs, cards A-F, V-Z, A2 and Mei's live-board card. Gate prompts (functional:11, polish:75, visual:103, constraints judge.toml hro_gate_shared) require 'a unique name and email (add a short suffix for this review)' and then 'exactly one card'. (b) Timed observations: functional prompt.md:21 and polish prompt.md:82 say 'Give every message, note or card created inside a timed action a unique suffix for this review so the watched text cannot match anything older'. This covers hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up, hro_seen, hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread. (c) Role replays: functional prompt.md:17 requires 'an add-candidate with a new unique name and email, an open-job with a new unique title, a note with new text'. (d) Fixed literals were checked by grep against environment/assets/seed_data.json and the reference markup and JS (public/index.html, js/app.js, board.js, threads.js, src, server.js). 'plain' (hro_msg_compose): '' has 0 hits in the seed and 0 in the reference. 'plain' has 1 seed hit, as a substring of 'explained' in the generated_note value, not a message. Its 2 reference hits are the MIME type 'text/plain' in drag code at board.js:242 and :303, never rendered. 'Call back on Fri' (hro_pol_live_board): 0 hits in either. 'J1', 'J2', 'J3': 0 hits in either. The seed's 3 jobs are Platform Engineer, Data Analyst and Product Designer. 'draft' and 'Draft': 0 seed hits; the seed has no drafts table. 'JUDGE' and 'probe': 0 hits. (e) tomas.varga@candidates.example (hro_candidate_linked) is a seeded account. Seeded APP-201 links Tomas only to Data Analyst (JOB-DATA), and the probe adds him to a new suffixed J2. Only the appearance of that new J2 card passes, so the seeded link cannot pre-satisfy it. The prompt also covers the case where the address is already on J2 ('open a new job J3'). (f) Mutation outcomes are bound to judge-created records, so seeded state cannot satisfy them. The rejected card with its reason, the Hired card, Activity lines and notes are all on J1/J2 cards; the seed has no activity list. Seeded notes are only on APP-101, APP-107 and APP-301. The only seeded rejection is Lena's APP-301 on Product Designer. (g) Some values are intentional reads of seeded state, not mutation probes: Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' in Z and D, the Platform Engineer order, Lena's 1 unread (reads USR-CAN3 APP-301 read_count 2 of 3), Noor's 120 messages, and Tomas's Data Analyst 'In review' (seed SCREEN maps to 'In review'). Each is used as a baseline or as a read-only value and none proves a mutation. In hro_restart, the seeded baseline is read before the restart and judge-created records are compared after it, so an app that reseeds and wipes data still fails. Unread and seen counts are relative ('rises by exactly two', 'computed from the observed sequence'). (h) The reference's initial state is the seed alone. src/db.js:61-84 seedIfEmpty inserts only users, jobs, applications, messages, reads and notes from seed_data.json, with no extra activity, drafts or messages. The two seed copies are byte-identical (sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740). That hash, and the hashes of index.html, app.js, board.js and threads.js, match raw-evidence-index.json. (i) Leftover drafts are not pre-satisfied: polish prompt.md:78 says 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own'. Lessons file: the lessons that bear on this row are 7/14 (timed-step unique markers) and 15 (several distinct revisions re-read after a real restart). Both apply here: timed actions require unique suffixes, and hro_restart compares all judge-created jobs, order, notes, messages, unread counts and Activity lines, not one seeded record. No instance of a pre-satisfied probe was found. Plausible broken app tried: an app that shows the seeded Tomas application, or does not create cards and messages. It fails, because every probe targets a suffixed new J2 card, job or message. Conforming alternative tried: an app whose UI text contains 'plain', 'draft' or 'new message' (the reference does). It is unaffected, because probes are matched on judge-chosen suffixed text in specific records, not on bare words. Latent P3 observation, not a defect: notes in protocol N and Rafael's first 'plain' message are outside timed actions and need no suffix. They are still created on new J1 cards and a new J2 conversation, which hold no seeded or earlier text. The fallback seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201) has 3 seed messages, none containing '' or 'plain'. Evidence type: source and grep review only, which suffices for this static row (owned by check-probe-not-in-seed.py). The private checker executable was not run, and no configured judge run was used.
